disposition: The engine seam implements bounded one-batch-then-ack subscriptions with an explicit terminal close status, and a typed wire contract now exists (backbone.subscribe with subscription_batch/subscription_closed frames served by SyncDeliveryHost over UDS), closing part of the P0 gap; still missing are heartbeats, SubscriptionOpeningStrategy/compression/buffer-size negotiation, CloseWhenNoDocsLeft/IgnoreSubscriberErrors, and distinct document-vs-revision batch payloads, and the engine-backed host routes backbone delivery to the sync-delivery host beside it.
